q: The class BPP (bounded-error probabilistic polynomial time) and its relationship to entropy: a language L ∈ BPP iff there is a probabilistic TM M with:
opts: P(M(x)=L(x)) = 1 for x ∈ L and = 0 for x ∉ L
P(M(x)=1) > 1/2 for x ∈ L and = 0 for x ∉ L
exp: BPP: M runs in poly time and P(M(x)=L(x)) ≥ 3/4. The error can be amplified: running k independent copies and majority-voting gives error 2^{-Θ(k)}. The entropy of the coin flips used is O(poly(n)) bits, giving the resource-theoretic interpretation.
